### LOW: Opt\-in resident RAM prefix reuse for Super contradicts the T\-041 'no production RAM tier' posture
[changelog\.d/nemotron\-super\-media\-discovery\.md:57](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/a0eae678c03c24a23e327e6bd6995ffb55eb0bca/changelog.d/nemotron-super-media-discovery.md#L57) · T-028, T-041

The changelog adds \`DARKBLOOM\_PREFIX\_CACHE\_MEMORY=1\`, which opts the plain Nemotron Super owner into a resident recurrent checkpoint bank\. Its budget is reserved from load until retirement, and a restored request continues from checkpoints at prefill\-chunk multiples\. T\-041 and hardware\-support\.md state that production never constructs a resident\-RAM prefix cache and that encrypted SSD is the sole tier\. The visible text does not say how the bank is scoped by the coordinator\-authored cacheSalt \(account, model build, prompt contract\), whether checkpoint contents are encrypted, or how they are wiped at retirement\. The bank also adds a cross\-request TTFT hit/miss oracle with no TTL\. Only the changelog and docs were supplied, so the code is unreviewed\. If the bank is ever served beyond a single trusted tenant, hits could cross account scopes\. Fix: before enabling, update T\-041 and TB\-007 to cover this tier \(scope key, lifetime, zeroization, same\-account\-only reuse\)\. Require cacheSalt in the checkpoint key and keep the flag out of any registered or production path\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5

### LOW: Docs add a resident\-RAM, unscoped prefix\-cache path that T\-041 says does not exist
[docs/architecture/inference\.md:128](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/a0eae678c03c24a23e327e6bd6995ffb55eb0bca/docs/architecture/inference.md#L128) · A-001, T-041

The new section describes an owner\-resident recurrent checkpoint bank, enabled by DARKBLOOM\_PREFIX\_CACHE\_MEMORY=1\. Text requests use it with "the local unscoped cache scope"\. T\-041 states that production never constructs a resident\-RAM prefix cache and that cacheSalt is coordinator\-authored per account, model build and prompt contract\. The doc says this path is unregistered, has no production caller, and exposes no route\. As written it is not a regression\. But if the Nemotron Super owner or its local HTTP hook \(NemotronSuperLocalImageHTTP\) is ever wired to coordinator or multi\-tenant traffic, requests would share one scope\. That would reopen the cross\-account TTFT oracle that T\-041 and SEC\-035 treat as closed\. The checkpoint bank would also add RAM\-resident prompt\-derived state outside the SSD tier's HMAC, TTL and KEK controls\. T\-041 should be updated to say this tier is local\-only and unscoped, and that wiring it to coordinator traffic requires a fresh sign\-off with coordinator\-supplied cacheSalt\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5
